items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had the Oldham boys in that last band, too... Bill Oldham on bass violin

ctx.x: Because the banjo and tuba were -- by that time, most of the bands had switched to string bass and guitar. But why the banjo, particularly, and the tuba on some things?
Well, let's see, Bill Oldham did have a tuba, I believe. But he didn't have it in the '34 band. See, I had the Oldham boys in that last band, too.
Oh, But in the '33 bands, on the records, sometimes he plays tuba, but most of the time he plays string bass.
